# JSON dependency

Unmodified single header `nlohmann/json` v3.11.3, MIT license in `LICENSE.MIT`.
Used only for configuration and result serialization, not in the mining loop.
No download or package installation is required by CMake.

Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.11.3

Downloaded header: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.11.3/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp

SHA-256 (verified against the published release):
`9bea4c8066ef4a1c206b2be5a36302f8926f7fdc6087af5d20b417d0cf103ea6`.
